request_messages.content:
Extract this person's own facts using only the vocabulary. "unknown" if not stated. Set attributes return a list. Return {"facts": {...}}.
- topic (single): statistics = this person studies statistics; programming = this person studies programming; language_practice = this person practises a language
- format (single): independent = this person studies alone but alongside someone; discussion = this person works through problems together with the partner; tutoring = this person wants a guided walkthrough session where one person explains and the other follows; this says nothing about which side they are on
- quiet (single): silent = this person needs complete silence while working; occasional_talk = this person is fine with occasional short exchanges; interactive = this person prefers talking things through continuously
- tutor_role (single): none = this person wants no tutoring either way; learn = this person wants things explained to them (a learner); teach = this person is willing to explain things (a tutor)
- venue (set): online = this person can meet online; in_person = this person can meet in person
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings

I am a Turkish person in my early 30s with a background in history. Outside of my studies, I enjoy baking sourdough because I love the process of creating something from scratch. I am currently studying language practice. I work best when studying independently side by side. I need talking things through as we go. There is no tutoring either way. I can meet in person. I am free on Saturday afternoons or weekday evenings.

Extract (1) the requirements this person places on a partner: attribute, accepted_values (vocabulary values the PARTNER must hold), strength = required ONLY when the wording is unconditional (must / need / have to / only / no ... please / deal-breaker unless); strong_preference when it is called important but explicitly not required ('really matters ... though not a requirement', 'strongly prefer', 'big plus'); preference for light wishes ('nice if', 'small bonus', 'ideally'). Who does what: 'you to be the one who coaches me' means the PARTNER coaches (partner value teach); (2) changes_this_time: anything the person says is different from usual for THIS occasion, as attribute + their own value this time (empty list if none). Return {"requirements": [...], "changes_this_time": [...]}.
- topic (single): statistics = this person studies statistics; programming = this person studies programming; language_practice = this person practises a language
- format (single): independent = this person studies alone but alongside someone; discussion = this person works through problems together with the partner; tutoring = this person wants a guided walkthrough session where one person explains and the other follows; this says nothing about which side they are on
- quiet (single): silent = this person needs complete silence while working; occasional_talk = this person is fine with occasional short exchanges; interactive = this person prefers talking things through continuously
- tutor_role (single): none = this person wants no tutoring either way; learn = this person wants things explained to them (a learner); teach = this person is willing to explain things (a tutor)
- venue (set): online = this person can meet online; in_person = this person can meet in person
- time_window (set): sat_morning = free on Saturday morning; sat_afternoon = free on Saturday afternoon; sun_morning = free on Sunday morning; sun_afternoon = free on Sunday afternoon; weekday_evening = free on weekday evenings

I need you to be into studying independently side by side, and you have to be okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges. It would matter a lot if we overlap on in person, though it's not a requirement. I'd strongly prefer that you are available weekday evenings or Saturday afternoon, but I won't rule you out over it. It's a small bonus if you are into statistics.
